lost_detail_risk.thin_lines: High risk of anti-aliasing attenuation when 1-2px lines are averaged over 16x16 blocks.
lost_detail_risk.small_interior_text: CRITICAL RISK: Interior text labels ('EDV', 'RJ45') occupy <5% of a 16x16 block, getting smoothed out into near-zero intensity.
lost_detail_risk.geometric_differences: High risk: socket (circle) vs edv (circle + internal text) look identical at 16x16 spatial resolution.

recommendation: Increase primary spatial grid resolution to 32x32 (or 32x16 max-pooled detail maps) and introduce local max-pooling/high-pass filtering to preserve sub-pixel interior text details.
